name: grok-build-vscode
description: Unofficial community extension (not affiliated with xAI). Hybrid ACP client: native VS Code UI over the official Grok Build CLI (grok agent stdio). Multi-session, plan/execute, diffs, context.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Grok Build needs a trusted workspace to write files, apply edits, and run terminal tools. In Restricted Mode only chat/read features work reliably.

commands.title: Trust Folder for Grok CLI (load project hooks, rules, skills)

grokBuild.cliPath.description: Path to the Grok Build CLI executable. Default `grok`: PATH, then ~/.local/bin, ~/.grok/bin, /usr/local/bin. An explicit path is used as-is (no fallback); if it does not exist or is not executable, an error banner with Open Setting is shown.

grokBuild.cliArgs.description: Arguments passed to the Grok CLI to start the ACP agent.

enumDescriptions: Open Grok as a tab in the middle editor area (Explorer stays on the left)
Open Grok in the left activity-bar sidebar (replaces Explorer while open)
grokBuild.openLocation.description: Where to show the Grok Build chat. Prefer “editor” for Files + Chat side by side.

grokBuild.defaultMode.description: Default agent mode for new sessions.

grokBuild.defaultModel.description: CLI -m / --model. Empty = CLI default (e.g. grok-4.5). Use Model button or /model to change.

grokBuild.reasoningEffort.description: CLI --reasoning-effort (alias --effort). Empty = agent default. Values depend on the model.

grokBuild.cliPermissionMode.description: CLI --permission-mode (agent tool policy, passed as top-level flag before `agent`). Empty = CLI default. `plan`: from Grok CLI 1.0.65 the agent really starts in plan mode and new sessions show Plan in the UI (older CLIs start in the default mode). `auto`: Grok auto-allows routine tool calls and shows a permission card for the rest; since CLI 1.0.64 a shell command runs without a prompt only if every sub-command (each part of a `&&`, `;` or `|` chain) matches an allowlist rule, so chained commands prompt more often. Separate from UI permission prompts below.
enumDescriptions: Classifier auto-allows routine calls; since CLI 1.0.64 every sub-command of a shell chain must match the allowlist
Deny whatever would need a prompt
Plan only (real plan start from CLI 1.0.65)

grokBuild.alwaysApprove.description: CLI --always-approve: auto-approve all tool executions in the agent process.

grokBuild.noPlan.description: CLI --no-plan: disable plan mode in the agent.

enumDescriptions: Follow Grok CLI config (`[memory] enabled` in ~/.grok/config.toml). No override.
grokBuild.memory.markdownDescription: Cross-session memory (Grok CLI ≥1.0.51: on/off only). Passed to the agent as env `GROK_MEMORY`; `default` keeps the CLI config. Pinned/managed CLI settings may override this.

grokBuild.noMemory.markdownDeprecationMessage: Deprecated: CLI 1.0.51 removed `--no-memory`. Use `#grokBuild.memory#` = `off`. Still honored (mapped to `GROK_MEMORY=0`) when `grokBuild.memory` is `default`.

grokBuild.experimentalMemory.markdownDeprecationMessage: Deprecated: CLI 1.0.51 removed `--experimental-memory`. Use `#grokBuild.memory#` = `on`. Still honored (mapped to `GROK_MEMORY=1`) when `grokBuild.memory` is `default` and `noMemory` is off.

grokBuild.disableWebSearch.description: CLI --disable-web-search: disable web search and fetch tools.

grokBuild.rules.description: CLI --rules: extra rules appended to the system prompt.

grokBuild.extraCliArgs.description: Advanced: extra agent-level args inserted after `agent` (e.g. ["--agent-profile", "C:\\path\\profile"]). Top-level-only flags (--permission-mode, --max-turns, --tools, …) must use their dedicated settings; `grok agent` rejects them.

grokBuild.autoIncludeActiveFile.description: Automatically include the active editor file as context when sending a prompt.

grokBuild.autoIncludeSelection.description: Automatically include the current selection as context when sending a prompt.

enumDescriptions: Auto-select the one-shot allow option for each request; never grants session-wide approval. Prompts if the agent offers no one-shot option.
Auto-select the one-shot allow option for every request in this VS Code session; switching back to Ask takes effect immediately.
Auto-select the allow-always option and start the CLI with --always-approve.
grokBuild.permissionMode.description: Extension UI: how to answer ACP session/request_permission dialogs (not the same as CLI --permission-mode). Options are chosen by ACP kind, never by name or order.

grokBuild.showDiffBeforeApply.description: After a successful write, offer a non-blocking toast with Show Diff. Writes are always applied immediately so the agent is not blocked.

grokBuild.autoAllowInExecuteMode.description: In Execute mode, auto-allow tool permissions so the agent is not blocked on a hidden dialog. Plan mode still prompts.

grokBuild.maxContextFileBytes.description: Maximum bytes of a single file to embed as context.

grokBuild.sessionHistoryLimit.description: Maximum number of sessions to keep in local history.

grokBuild.updateRepo.description: GitHub repository (owner/name) for extension update checks via Releases.

grokBuild.githubToken.description: Optional GitHub token for private-repo release checks. Prefer VS Code GitHub sign-in when possible.

grokBuild.checkPrereleaseUpdates.description: Include prerelease GitHub releases in extension update checks.

grokBuild.enableTerminal.description: Allow the agent to run terminal commands via ACP terminal/* methods.

grokBuild.logLevel.description: Extension log level (Output channel: Grok Build).

colors.description: Background for user messages in Grok Build chat.
Background for agent messages in Grok Build chat.
